  "rules": {
    "activity": {
      "window_days": 10,
      "max": 18,
      "source": "S1",
      "note": "窗口是 S1 表格抬头逐字:「if descriptor is present at the time of the visit or in the preceding 10 days」。满分 18 = §B.2 对这 8 条逐字权重的加总(2+2+4+4+4+4+1+1)。⚠️ DORIS 2021 另记「the SLEDAI assesses disease activity over the previous 30 days in most clinical trials」—— 两句都成立,本包按表格原文取 10 天。",
      "items": [
        {"id": "low_complement", "label": "低补体", "weight": 2, "kind": "flag_low",
         "any_of": ["complement_c3", "complement_c4", "ch50"], "source": "S1",
         "note": "S1 Table 2 逐字:「Decrease in CH50, C3, or C4 below the lower limit of normal for testing laboratory」。阈值是**该报告自己印的下限**,不是固定数字。"},
        {"id": "dsdna_high", "label": "dsDNA 升高", "weight": 2, "kind": "flag_high",
         "any_of": ["anti_dsdna"],
         "qualitative_positive": ["阳性", "强阳性", "+"],
         "caveat": "表格原文写的是 Farr 法;中国实验室多用 ELISA/CLIFT,按定义存在偏差",
         "source": "S1",
         "note": "S1 Table 2 逐字:「Increased DNA binding by Farr assay above normal range for testing laboratory.」同样是实验室相对阈值。"},
        {"id": "proteinuria", "label": "蛋白尿", "weight": 4, "kind": "gt",
         "key": "urine_protein_24h", "threshold": 0.5, "threshold_unit": "g/24h", "source": "S1",
         "note": "S1 Table 2 逐字:「Proteinuria — >0.5 gram/24 hours」。包里写源行原值 0.5 g/24h,换算到报告印的单位由词典做 —— 在包里先手算成 500 mg,读包的人就看不出它不是源行原值了。UPCR 不替代计分(spec §5.2),只在趋势里单独画。"},
        {"id": "hematuria", "label": "血尿", "weight": 4, "kind": "gt",
         "key": "urine_rbc_hpf", "threshold": 5, "threshold_unit": "/[HPF]",
         "caveat": "需排除结石、感染或其它原因,需医生确认", "source": "S1",
         "note": "S1 Table 2 逐字:「>5 red blood cells/high power field. Exclude stone, infection or other cause.」"},
        {"id": "pyuria", "label": "脓尿", "weight": 4, "kind": "gt",
         "key": "urine_wbc_hpf", "threshold": 5, "threshold_unit": "/[HPF]",
         "caveat": "需排除感染,需医生确认", "source": "S1",
         "note": "S1 Table 2 逐字:「>5 white blood cells/high power field. Exclude infection.」"},
        {"id": "casts", "label": "管型", "weight": 4, "kind": "text_present",
         "patterns": ["红细胞管型"], "source": "S1",
         "note": "§B.1 的描述符是「Heme-granular or red blood cell casts.」。红细胞管型有 §A.3 的 VERBATIM 中文写法(2019 中国狼疮肾炎指南 S16 印「红细胞管型」);含血颗粒管型那一半没有 —— 「颗粒管型」比 heme-granular 宽(发热/脱水/运动后都可见),不是这条描述符,故不入。待 Task 19 核到中文写法再补。"},
        {"id": "leukopenia", "label": "白细胞减少", "weight": 1, "kind": "lt",
         "key": "wbc", "threshold": 3.0, "threshold_unit": "10*9/L", "source": "S1",
         "note": "S1 表格印的是「< 3,000 white blood cells / x10⁹/L」—— 单位自相矛盾(3,000/mm³ = 3.0 ×10⁹/L)。§B.2 明确按 3.0 ×10⁹/L 实现,并把矛盾标出来、不静默改写。"},
        {"id": "thrombocytopenia", "label": "血小板减少", "weight": 1, "kind": "lt",
         "key": "plt", "threshold": 100, "threshold_unit": "10*9/L", "source": "S1",
         "note": "同上:表格印「<100,000 platelets / x10⁹/L」,§B.2 按 100 ×10⁹/L 实现。"}
      ]
    },
